items.title: Trump says he would accept 20-year Iranian uranium enrichment suspension if Tehran gives 'real' guarantee
items.summary: Trump, speaking on Air Force One departing China on May 15, signaled flexibility on the core nuclear demand — shifting from permanent cessation to a 20-year suspension — though Iranian FM Araghchi responded that Tehran has 'no trust' in the US.

items.title: Kuwait captures four IRGC-linked operatives who infiltrated Bubiyan Island; two identified as Naval Colonels
items.summary: Kuwait's Foreign Ministry announced the arrest of four members of Iran's IRGC, including two Naval Colonels, who infiltrated Bubiyan Island reportedly tasked with carrying out hostile operations against Kuwaiti territory.

items.title: Iran rial: 1,805,000 IRR/USD on May 18 — down slightly from 1,819,000 yesterday, still 9.75% below 2M portfolio threshold
items.summary: The remittance rate on AlanChand shows USD at 1,805,000 IRR on May 18, a 10,000 IRR (+0.56%) increase from Sunday; the free-market bonbast rate and official rate continue to diverge significantly.

items.title: Hormuz transit at ~5% of pre-war average; 600+ tankers trapped in Persian Gulf, 240 waiting outside
items.summary: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser reported May 11 that over 600 tankers are stuck inside the Persian Gulf and 240 are waiting outside; UANI's May 13 tracker confirms commercial transit running at roughly 5% of pre-war average.

items.title: Round 4 Oman nuclear talks: Iran proposes 3-step deal — lower enrichment to 3.67%, frozen assets, then oil exports
items.summary: The fourth round of indirect US-Iran talks in Oman on May 11 lasted 3+ hours; Iran's FM Araghchi and US envoy Witkoff communicated via Omani intermediaries and briefly spoke in person, with both sides calling talks 'difficult but constructive'.

items.title: Polymarket: Iran airspace closure by May 24 at 34%; US invasion before 2027 at 32%; Hormuz normal by June 30 at 28%
items.summary: Fresh Polymarket data: airspace closure by May 24 priced at 34% (notable short-fuse escalation signal), US invasion before 2027 up to 32%, Hormuz normalization by June 30 at 28%, permanent peace deal by May 31 at 8%.

items.title: Trump claims Iran hostilities 'have terminated' in Congress letter — skirting May 1 War Powers deadline
items.summary: Trump sent a letter to Congress asserting that hostilities with Iran have 'terminated,' effectively sidestepping the War Powers Resolution's 60-day deadline that expired May 1, 2026.
